text:
harper: Heads-up: proposing a multi-wave refactor to shrink the hotpath by extracting request-router responsibilities out of the runtime and into a thin router-service. Goal: reduce p95 variability and make runtime stateless.
oliver: +1. Need to nail ownership for shared responsibilities: KV cache, billing hooks, and webhook delivery.
sana: My main concern is cache stampede and double-write during cutover. Suggest single-writer window and a read-hint API for the new router.
ben: Operational constraints: each wave must support per-tenant circuit-breakers and a rollback lane. We should automate rollback on error-budget tripping.
harper: Safety fences I'm thinking: canary lane (mirror -> 48h), graded ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), and a "safety-lattice" that encodes per-tenant latency and correctness thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Router-service canary deployed -> image router:2024-11-03-canary -> 3 nodes in canary-pool. Monitoring hooks created.
sana: For correctness: semantic diff set + golden prompt-set. Tolerate non-semantic reordering. Add regression alert tied to prompt-set.
oliver: Billing & cost: surface token-cost deltas during ramps in the console and emit billing-preview events. Provide opt-out flag for customers. Product must show an explanatory banner.
harper: Cache ownership plan:
- Phase A: router owns cache writes during migration, runtime only reads via ReadHint(key)
- Phase B: after 60 days of zero fallback, run ownership flip job to move writes to runtime
- Phase C: prune shim code after 90 days of stable traffic
ben: Idempotency: router will attach idempotency-key for side-effects until we confirm exactly-once. Webhooks must be exact-once; keep orch-layer dedupe for 30d.
sana: Runbook sketch:
1) enable feature-flag for tenant in staging + run smoke
2) mirror traffic (100%) for 48h, run semantic diffs
3) enable 1% traffic to router for selected tenants, hold 24h, validate metrics
4) ramp per wave, run preset audits, then flip 100%
5) safe-slab: keep legacy runtime fallback available for 30d, then prune if unused
Commands:
```bash
# enable mirror for tenant
./ffctl set router-extract tenant-73 mirror=true
# preview billing delta
./billingctl preview tenant-73 --target=router-service
```
harper: Observability contract: router emits trace-context, route-level tags (tenant_id, route_version), and a diff-hash for semantic comparisons. Dashboards: per-tenant rollout card + global "safety-lattice" view.
monitor-bot: monitor-bot: Alerts established: p95-latency-delta, semantic-diff-rate, 5xx-rate, webhook-dup-errors. Dashboard card created under "Rollouts".
oliver: Dev ergonomics: need a local compose profile to run runtime+router+lite-cache. Also update SDK to propagate new error codes and route headers.
sana: Data migration: export small cache snapshots for hot-tenants and provide a load script to inject into router cache to avoid cold-start storms. Ops to provide tooling.
harper: Action items:
- Sana: cache ownership spec + inject script (ETA 4d)
- Oliver: billing preview events + console banner (ETA 5d)
- Ben: rollout automation + rollback-on-error-budget (ETA 6d)
- Harper: prototype router shim + CI job (ETA 7d)
We'll reconvene in 48 hours to review PRs and canary metrics. :calendar: 
oliver: ack. I'll loop in product for the banner wording.
